In winter we travel to Switzerland.

Sie kommt aus der Schweiz.
She comes from Switzerland.
Notes: Country with article: die Schweiz, die Türkei, die USA. in der Schweiz (in) / in die Schweiz (to). Person: der Schweizer / die Schweizerin.

Synonyms (3): die Krankenschwester (nurse), die Geschwister (siblings)

My sister is happy.

I have two sisters.

Die Schwester misst Fieber.
The nurse takes the temperature.

Sedimentation takes years.

Sandstone forms through sedimentation.

Die Sedimentation am Flussboden ist stark.

We go to the seaside.

The sea is calm today.

Das Schiff fährt auf hoher See.
The ship sails on the high seas.

Synonyms (3): die Attraktion, das Wahrzeichen (landmark), das Highlight

We tour many sights.

Hamburg hat viele Sehenswürdigkeiten.
Hamburg has many sights.

Was ist die größte Sehenswürdigkeit der Stadt?
What is the biggest attraction of the city?

Synonyms (3): das Blatt (sheet), die Fläche (surface), die Flanke (flank)

Open page ten.

Auf der linken Seite steht das Bett.
On the left side stands the bed.

Die Webseite hat viele Seiten.
The website has many pages.

Synonyms (3): die Assistentin (assistant, f), die Bürokraft (office worker)

The secretary calls the customer.

I ask the secretary about the appointment.

Synonyms (3): die Obduktion (autopsy), die Leichenöffnung (opening of a body), die Abteilung (department)

The dissection shows the cause of death.

The club has a section for hiking.

Die Sektion ist Teil der Untersuchung.
The dissection is part of the investigation.

Synonyms (3): die Auswahl (choice), die Auslese (picking out), die Aussortierung (sorting out)

Die Selektion der Kandidaten läuft.
The selection of the candidates is under way.

Natürliche Selektion treibt die Evolution an.
Natural selection drives evolution.

Nach der Selektion bleiben nur zehn Bewerber.
After the selection only ten applicants remain.
Notes: Verb: selektieren. Auswahl is the everyday word. Pattern: -ieren → -ektion (irregular).

The selectivity of the test is important.

Chemists raise the selectivity of the reaction.

Synonyms (3): die Show (show), das Programm (programme), die Ausstrahlung (broadcast)

My favourite programme is on in the evening.

Die Sendung ist morgen in der Mediathek.
The programme will be in the Mediathek tomorrow.
Notes: Verb: senden. Also a parcel: die Paketsendung. Compounds: die Fernsehsendung, die Nachrichtensendung. Seen in the practice test.

Synonyms (3): das Greisenalter (old age), die Altersschwäche (senility), die Vergreisung (becoming old)

Senility is a medical term.

Ärzte sprechen von Senilität bei starker Vergesslichkeit.
Doctors speak of senility with severe forgetfulness.

Das Wort Senilität klingt heute abwertend.
The word senility sounds derogatory today.

Synonyms (3): das Dienstalter (seniority), das Alter (age), der Dienstrang (rank)

Seniority counts in pay.

Seniority counts for pay.

Synonyms (3): die Feinfühligkeit (sensitivity), die Empfindsamkeit (sensitiveness), die Einfühlsamkeit (empathy)

She has a lot of sensitivity.

He speaks about the topic with sensitivity.
Example 3:

Children need sensitivity from teachers.

Synonyms (3): die Empfindlichkeit (sensitivity), die Messgenauigkeit (measurement precision), die Trefferquote (hit rate)

The sensitivity of the test is high.

The sensitivity of the test is 95 percent.

Doctors check sensitivity and specificity.
Notes: Medical and statistical term. Adjective: sensitiv.

Synonyms (3): die Gefühlsseligkeit (sentimentality), die Rührseligkeit (mawkishness), die Wehmut (wistfulness)

The sentimentality of the songs moves many.
Example 3:

She collects things out of sentimentality.
Notes: Adjective: sentimental. Often slightly negative.

Separating waste helps the environment.

After the separation the oil is pure.

Synonyms (3): die Reihenhaftigkeit (seriality), die Abfolge (sequence), die Wiederholung (repetition)

The seriality of TV series attracts viewers.

Synonyms (3): die Fernsehserie (TV series), die Reihe (series), die Staffel (season)

The series has three seasons.

A series of accidents is frightening.

Synonyms (3): die Glaubwürdigkeit (credibility), die Ernsthaftigkeit (seriousness), die Zuverlässigkeit (reliability)

The credibility of the website is doubtful.

A suit emphasises seriousness.

Synonyms (3): die Dienstleistungsqualität (service quality), die Kundenfreundlichkeit (customer friendliness)

The food was great!

Synonyms (3): die sportliche Betätigung (sporting activity), der Sport (sport), die Bewegung (movement)

My sports activity is highest at the weekend.

The club offers many sports activities.

Synonyms (3): die Athletin (athlete), die Wettkämpferin (competitor), ~die Spielerin (player)

We ask the athletes after training.

There are interviews in the sports programme.

Synonyms (3): die Zunge (~ tongue, poetic), der Dialekt (~ dialect), die Ausdrucksweise (way of expressing)

Which languages do you speak?

German is a beautiful language.

Did you hear my voice message?

Synonyms (3): der Geschirrspüler (dishwasher), die Geschirrspülmaschine (dishwasher)

I load the dishwasher.

The dishwasher is full.

We buy a new dishwasher.

Synonyms (3): das Opernhaus (opera house), die Oper (opera), das Staatstheater (state theatre)

We go to the state opera.

The state opera is in Berlin.

Tickets for the state opera are expensive.

Synonyms (3): die Festigkeit (firmness), die Standfestigkeit (steadiness), die Beständigkeit (constancy)
Antonyms (3): die Instabilität (instability), die Labilität (instability), die Unsicherheit (insecurity)

The stability of the economy is important.

Die Stabilität der Brücke wird geprüft.
The stability of the bridge is checked.

Politische Stabilität zieht Investoren an.
Political stability attracts investors.
Notes: Adjective: stabil (you saw labil as opposite).

Synonyms (3): die Großstadt (big city), die Metropole (metropolis), die Ortschaft (~ locality)
Antonyms (3): das Dorf (village), das Land (countryside), die Natur (nature)

Berlin is a big city.

I like living in the city.

Wir fahren in die Stadt.
We go into town.

Synonyms (3): der Stadtverkehr (urban traffic), die Mobilität in der Stadt (mobility in the city)

Urban mobility is a topic in politics.

Urban mobility needs good buses and cycle paths.

Berlin plans the urban mobility of the future.
Notes: Stadt + Mobilität.

Synonyms (3): der Stillstand (standstill), die Flaute (lull), die Stockung (hold-up)

The stagnation continues.

The economy suffers from stagnation.

After years of stagnation the company is growing again.
Notes: Verb: stagnieren. Finance word. Pattern: -ieren → -ation.

Synonyms (3): die Unveränderlichkeit (unchangeability), die Gleichbleibendheit (constancy), die Beständigkeit (constancy)

Stationarity is a term in statistics.

Stationarity means: the mean stays the same.

Time series should show stationarity.
Notes: Statistics term. Adjective: stationär (also: inpatient in hospital).

Synonyms (3): die Erhebung (survey), die Zahlen (the figures)
Example 1:

The statistics show an increase.

I study statistics.
Example 3:

According to statistics, fifty thousand people live here.
Notes: Adjective: statistisch. Plural: die Statistiken (single statistics). Subject name has no plural.

At this spot there is a traffic jam.

In your position I would wait.

The sterilization of the devices is compulsory.

After sterilization the bottles are germ-free.
Example 3:

The sterilization of cats is common.
Notes: Verb: sterilisieren. Also: die Sterilisierung. Two meanings: removing germs and making unable to have offspring.

The sterility of the room is important.

Sterility in the operating room is important.
Example 3:

After the treatment infertility is possible.
Notes: Two meanings: germ-free and infertile. Adjective: steril.

The voters' votes count.

Synonyms (3): die Stabilität der Wirtschaft (stability of the economy), die Konjunktursicherheit (economic security)
